title: Review missed answers and discover the newest course updates
summary: The Learn dashboard now opens the worked explanations for missed Daily case answers. You can mark those explanations reviewed so the next suggestion moves forward. New approved courses and major feature announcements are shown newest first.

title: Daily cases now revisit topics you missed
summary: Completed case-study answers on this browser can guide the next reviewed Daily case toward a topic you missed. New learners keep the regular rotation; approved questions, saved answers and streaks remain unchanged.

title: Your next learning step, with a clearer route to rewards
summary: After completing available courses, see which Daily Practice answers need a closer look alongside your next recommended activity. Your first-trade journey now links to the Trophy Cabinet.

title: One clear next step in Learn
summary: Learn now suggests one next action based on your progress. Return to a lesson you started or keep practising after you finish the courses.
